content:
Renee H: small design sync — proposing a trimmed autoscale row for busy dashboards. Decisions needed: slider snap (5% vs 1%), inline min/max edit (typing vs stepper), and burst CTA wording.

Omar G: For most customers 5% is fine, but expose a tiny "Fine" control when they click the numeric value to switch to 1%. Keep defaults coarse to avoid noise. :+1:

Tess (FE): Implementation note: numeric input with hidden spin + visible steppers. Arrow keys adjust by step; Shift+arrow = larger jump. Will prototype behaviour in CodePen.

Kai (a11y): A11y items: 1) slider needs aria-valuenow/min/max and visible focus. 2) ensure stepper buttons have aria-labels (e.g., "increase min instances"). 3) burst modal must trap focus and use explicit CTA text like "Enable burst (+4 GPUs, 30m)".

Renee H: Burst copy options: short = "Enable burst: +{n} GPUs for up to {t} minutes. Billed while active." Longer = include auto-revert note. Which should be primary?

Omar G: Short for primary, but add a one-line secondary: "Auto-revert after {t} minutes unless extended." And link "How billing works".

Tess (FE): I'll wire the CTA label as suggested. Also proposing a compact preset popover for SLO chips (50/75/95) hidden by a chevron to save space.

Kai (a11y): Popover needs aria-expanded and keyboard focus handling. Announce when a preset is applied via aria-live polite: "SLO set to 95%".

ops-bot: Prototype uploaded: https://github.com/redwood/ui/protos/autoscale-mini (branch: renee/compact-row)

Renee H: Action items: Tess 1 prototype (due Tue), Kai 1 a11y checklist + sample markup, Omar 1 confirm copy wording. Closing after prototype review. Thanks!
